statement: At its pinned revision hid-nintendo expects nominal 15 ms Joy-Con full-report intervals, requires three consecutive input intervals in an 8–17 ms window before strictly rate-limited subcommands, uses a 60 ms Bluetooth minimum between subcommands and relaxes to the legacy policy after repeated failure to satisfy cadence.
